test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the word that is OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The project was __denounced__ as a scandalous waste of taxpayer’s money.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Defended". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**denounced**' means to publicly condemn or criticize something. (सार्वजनिक रूप से किसी बात की निंदा या आलोचना करना)

 
 
• **For example**: *The politician was denounced for his racist remarks.*
 
 
 
• The opposite of this would be to praise or approve of something.
 
• Marked option **Defended **means to support or protect something, which is the opposite of 'denounced'. (किसी चीज़ का समर्थन या सुरक्षा करना)
 
 
• **For example**: *The accused was defended by a team of skilled lawyers.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Described **is related to giving an account or explanation of something. (किसी बात का विवरण या स्पष्टीकरण देना)
 
• **Represented **is related to acting or speaking on behalf of something or someone. (किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति की ओर से कार्य करना या बोलना)
 
• **Decried **means to criticize something as bad, without value, or unnecessary. (किसी चीज़ को बुरा, बिना मूल्य का, या अनावश्यक कहकर आलोचना करना)
